many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

res = await refine.run(instructions='''Create a global memory for ARC task-e9fb55f9 with the verified rule. Input is a rectangular grid filled with color A, with an L-shaped border of color B along two adjacent edges. Output keeps dimensions. Recolor the outer original L border to A and most interior to 8. Draw an inner L of B on the row and column just inside the original border, stopping before their intersection so the cell diagonally adjacent to the original corner is 8. The original outer corner becomes 8. Draw a 45-degree diagonal of A through the 8 region, from near the outer corner opposite the L toward that final 8 cell. Diagonal placement depends on aspect ratio: for bottom/right L, square H=W has A at (0,0),(1,1),...,(H-3,W-3); wide W>H has A at (0,1),(1,2),...,(H-3,H-2); tall H>W has A at (1,0),(2,1),...,(H-3,W-3). The opposite outer corner is 8 unless it lies on the A diagonal. Other L orientations follow by rotation/reflection: bottom/left examples have diagonal near the bottom-left opposite corner, top/left near top-left, top/right near top-right.
